readout_conventions.cutoff: always shown in kHz, e.g. 12.00 kHz
readout_conventions.resonance: 0.707 (neutral) to 10.0, shown as a percentage of the travel

pads.name: Kick
pads.synthesis: sine with a fast pitch drop, a 1.8 ms beater click and a 0.14 - 1.44 s tail
pads.what_it_is: 808-style kick. The pitch envelope is what makes it fall instead of sweep.

pads.name: Snare
pads.synthesis: two body tones (185 Hz and 1.78x) plus band-passed noise at about 1.75 kHz
pads.what_it_is: Noise burst over a short tuned body, the classic snare recipe.

pads.name: Closed Hat
pads.synthesis: high-passed noise at about 7.8 kHz, 18 - 118 ms decay
pads.what_it_is: Short tick. Also chokes the open hat, like a real hi-hat pedal.

pads.name: Open Hat
pads.synthesis: the same noise source held open, 70 - 820 ms decay
pads.what_it_is: Longer wash of the closed hat sound.

pads.name: Clap
pads.synthesis: band-passed noise at about 1.05 kHz, re-hit three times 10 ms apart, then a tail
pads.what_it_is: The flam of a room full of hands, not a single burst.

pads.name: Rim
pads.synthesis: resonant sine at about 1.75 kHz plus a filtered click
pads.what_it_is: Short resonant ping, good for syncopated ticks.

pads.name: Tom
pads.synthesis: sine at about 118 Hz with a 1.5x pitch drop and a small noise attack

pads.name: Crash
pads.synthesis: high-passed noise at about 4.3 kHz plus three inharmonic partials
pads.what_it_is: Short crash wash, deliberately not a cymbal library.

parameters.name: Kick Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the kick's fundamental an octave down (0 %) or an octave up (100 %) around 48 Hz.
parameters.what_you_hear: Lower is a long subby boom, higher is a tight clicking kick.

parameters.name: Kick Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the tail length from 0.14 s to 1.44 s.
parameters.what_you_hear: Short is a punchy knock that leaves room for the bass. Long is an 808 that rings under the whole bar.

parameters.name: Kick Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: Louder or quieter against the other seven pads, nothing else changes.

parameters.name: Snare Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the snare body and noise band together, an octave either way.
parameters.what_you_hear: Down is a fat low snare, up is a tight crack.

parameters.name: Snare Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the noise tail from 0.06 s to 0.48 s.
parameters.what_you_hear: Short and dry, or a snare with room behind it.

parameters.name: Snare Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: Backbeat up or down against the kick.

parameters.name: Closed Hat Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the noise filter centre for the closed hat.
parameters.what_you_hear: Lower is a darker tick, higher is a thinner, brighter one.

parameters.name: Closed Hat Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the tick length from 18 ms to 118 ms.
parameters.what_you_hear: Tighter or looser hats, the main lever on how busy the pattern feels.

parameters.name: Closed Hat Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: Hats sitting under the kick and snare, or poking out over them.

parameters.name: Open Hat Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the noise filter centre for the open hat.
parameters.what_you_hear: A darker or glassier wash.

parameters.name: Open Hat Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the wash length from 70 ms to 820 ms.
parameters.what_you_hear: A quick open hat or one that hangs over the next beat.

parameters.name: Open Hat Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: Whether the open hat sits behind the groove or on top of it.

parameters.name: Clap Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the clap's band-pass centre.
parameters.what_you_hear: Down is a bigger room, up is a tighter, hand-clap crack.

parameters.name: Clap Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the tail after the three re-hits, 45 ms to 345 ms.
parameters.what_you_hear: A dry clap, or one with a room behind it.

parameters.name: Clap Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: Layered on the snare it thickens the backbeat; alone it carries it.

parameters.name: Rim Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the resonant ping and its noise band together.
parameters.what_you_hear: A woodblock at the bottom of the travel, a clave at the top.

parameters.name: Rim Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the ping length from 12 ms to 152 ms.
parameters.what_you_hear: A click or a short ringing knock.

parameters.name: Rim Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: A quiet tick in the background or a loud accent.

parameters.name: Tom Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the tom's fundamental an octave either way around 118 Hz.
parameters.what_you_hear: A floor tom at the bottom, a high tom at the top.

parameters.name: Tom Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the tom length from 0.10 s to 0.95 s.
parameters.what_you_hear: A tight fill tom or a long ringing one.

parameters.name: Tom Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: Whether the fill sits under the pattern or leads it.

parameters.name: Crash Tune
parameters.what_it_does: Moves the crash's noise filter and its three metallic partials.
parameters.what_you_hear: A dark trashy crash, or a thin bright one.

parameters.name: Crash Decay
parameters.what_it_does: Sets the wash length from 0.22 s to 1.72 s.
parameters.what_you_hear: A short accent at the top of the bar, or a wash that covers it.

parameters.name: Crash Level
parameters.what_it_does: How loud this pad is in the kit mix.
parameters.what_you_hear: A quiet marking or a full opening crash.

parameters.name: Filter Cutoff
parameters.what_it_does: Sets where the shared low-pass filter starts rolling off the whole kit.
parameters.what_you_hear: Down goes dark and muffled, up opens to full brightness. This is the knob that keeps the kick out of the way of the synth's bass.

parameters.name: Filter Resonance
parameters.what_it_does: How much the filter emphasises the frequencies right at the cutoff. 0.707 is neutral.
parameters.what_you_hear: A whistle appears at the cutoff and the kit takes on a squelchy character.

parameters.name: Swing
parameters.what_it_does: Delays every off-beat sixteenth. At 100 % an off-beat lands two thirds of the way through its pair, the classic triplet shuffle.
parameters.what_you_hear: Straight at 0 %, nudging at 30 %, a full shuffle near 100 %.

parameters.name: Master Level
parameters.what_it_does: The final volume of the whole kit, after the filter.
parameters.what_you_hear: Louder or quieter, nothing else changes.

sequencer.grid: one row per pad, one column per sixteenth note
sequencer.tempo: follows the host transport; free-runs at 130 BPM in the Standalone build
sequencer.sample_accuracy: hits are rendered at their sample offset inside the block

non_automatable_state.pattern: 128 characters of '0' and '1' (8 pads x 16 steps), saved in the plugin state tree

signal_chain.name: Eight one-shot voices
signal_chain.api: per-pad sine partials + noise through a state-variable filter
